fields.description: Issue includes extensive reporting of official vote totals for numerous Florida and Dade County primary election contests. Major editorial coverage focuses on Coral Gables city politics and the controversy surrounding George E. Merrick’s removal from the city commission, framing it within competing financial interests and bond financing. Additional pieces discuss visions of “Greater Miami,” local transportation and development ideas, support for local sports teams, and advocacy for the East Coast Canal bond issue election set for June 26. Regular society and humor columns appear alongside local news briefs, letters to the editor, and substantial advertising and entertainment listings.
